description: shapes module: closed, outward-wound triangle-soup generators — box_surface(min,max), sphere_surface(centre,r,n_lat,n_lon) (pebble/particle), cylinder_surface(base,r,h,n_seg) (fuel pin) — plus surface_volume(points,tris) via the divergence formula. Lets carve/carve_region mesh reactor geometry (coolant around a pebble = domain box minus sphere) with no blender dependency. Pure Rust. V&V: box vol exact; sphere/cylinder enclosed volume within a few % of analytic (UV discretisation); carve_region(box minus sphere) ~ box_vol - sphere_vol.
title: cfmesh: triangle-soup shape generators (box/sphere/cylinder) for reactor test geometry

description: carve_region currently lumps all boundary faces into one 'walls' patch. Separate them by which surface a face borders: outer/domain boundary -> 'walls', each hole -> 'hole_N'. Needed to apply distinct BCs (vessel wall vs fuel/pebble surface vs coolant in/out). Generalize assemble_kept to bucket boundary faces into named patches via a patch_of(neighbour) classifier; carve_region tags each non-kept cell with its containing hole. V&V: shell box-minus-box -> 2 patches ('walls'+'hole_0') with sensible face counts, faces sum to total boundary; carve_box unchanged (single 'walls' patch); foam bridge maps each patch to a PatchKind.
title: cfmesh: per-surface boundary patch separation

description: The htgr_sim_v1 primary helium loop uses first-cut placeholder correlations: lumped-node energy balance with constant cp_He, no real friction/pressure-drop, no fluid-array. Replace with real helium properties + pipe/pressure-drop model (tuas or tampines CompressibleFluidArray). Marked with // TODO in examples/htgr_sim_v1/physics/primary_loop.rs.
title: htgr_sim_v1: HTGR helium primary-loop TH correlations (scaffold placeholders)
